plot_cmeans_single <- function(FCM,
                               filename,
                               keep_clusters,
                               modality,
                               min_membership = 0,
                               common_ylim = TRUE,
                               ncol = 4L,
                               dpi = 250,
                               excel_path = NULL,
                               feature_label = "metabolites")
{
  if (class(FCM) != "fclust") {
    stop("`FCM` must be an object of class 'fclust'. See documentation ",
         "for details.")
  }
  
  min_membership <- max(0, min(min_membership, 1, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  if (missing(keep_clusters)) {
    keep_clusters <- as.integer(rownames(FCM[["centers"]]))
  }
  
  if (!(modality %in% c("Endur", "Resist"))) {
    stop("Invalid modality. Choose either 'Endur' or 'Resist'.")
  }
  
  excel_dir <- dirname(excel_path)
  plot_dir  <- dirname(filename)
  
  if (!dir.exists(excel_dir)) {
    dir.create(excel_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    message(glue::glue("📂 Created Excel output directory: {excel_dir}"))
  }
  
  if (!dir.exists(plot_dir)) {
    dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    message(glue::glue("📂 Created Plot output directory: {plot_dir}"))
  }
  
  mem <- FCM[["membership"]][, keep_clusters, drop = FALSE]
  centers <- FCM[["centers"]][keep_clusters, , drop = FALSE]
  colnames(mem) <- rownames(centers) <- paste0("Cluster ", colnames(mem))
  colnames(centers) <- sub("group_timepointADU([^ ]+) .*", "\\1", colnames(centers))
  colnames(centers) <- paste0("timepoint_", colnames(centers))
  
  zmat <- FCM[["input"]]
  colnames(zmat) <- sub("group_timepointADU([^ ]+) .*", "\\1", colnames(zmat))
  colnames(zmat) <- paste0("timepoint_", colnames(zmat))
  
  ## Include pre_exercise timepoint for the selected modality
  pre_ex <- matrix(data = 0, nrow = nrow(zmat), ncol = 1L)
  rownames(pre_ex) <- rownames(zmat)
  colnames(pre_ex) <- sprintf("timepoint_%s.pre_exercise", modality)
  
  zmat <- cbind(pre_ex, zmat)
  zmat <- zmat[, grep(modality, colnames(zmat))]
  
  # Include a column of zeros in the centers
  pre_ex_center <- matrix(data = 0, nrow = nrow(centers), ncol = 1L)
  rownames(pre_ex_center) <- rownames(centers)
  colnames(pre_ex_center) <- sprintf("timepoint_%s.pre_exercise", modality)
  
  centers <- cbind(centers, pre_ex_center)
  centers <- centers[, grep(modality, colnames(centers))]
  
  cluster_assignment <- data.frame(feature = names(FCM$cluster),
                                   cluster = paste0("Cluster ", FCM$cluster))
  
  z_df <- zmat %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("feature") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -feature,
                        names_to = "timepoint",
                        names_pattern = "timepoint_(.*)",
                        values_to = "z") %>%
    mutate(timepoint = gsub("(?<=\\d)_(?=\\d)", "/", timepoint, perl = TRUE),
           timepoint = gsub("_", " ", timepoint),
           timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint)))
  
  cluster_df <- mem %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("feature") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -feature,
                        names_to = "cluster",
                        values_to = "membership") %>%
    filter(membership >= min_membership) %>%
    inner_join(cluster_assignment, by = c("feature", "cluster")) %>%
    mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = rownames(centers)))
  
  df <- inner_join(z_df, cluster_df, by = "feature")  %>%
    arrange(cluster, membership) %>%
    mutate(feature = factor(feature, levels = unique(feature))) %>%
    droplevels.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = rownames(centers)))
  
  # Cluster centroids
  center_df <- centers %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("cluster") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -cluster,
                        names_to = "timepoint",
                        names_pattern = "timepoint_(.*)",
                        values_to = "center") %>%
    mutate(timepoint = gsub("(?<=\\d)_(?=\\d)", "/", timepoint, perl = TRUE),
           timepoint = gsub("_", " ", timepoint),
           timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint)),
           cluster = factor(cluster, levels = rownames(centers)))
  
  if (common_ylim) {
    ylim <- range(df$z)
  } else {
    ylim <- rep(NA, 2L)
  }
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(timepoint = gsub("^(Endur|Resist)\\.", "", timepoint))%>%
    mutate(timepoint = case_when(
      timepoint == "pre exercise" ~ "Pre-Exercise",
      timepoint == "during 20 min" ~ "During 20 Min",
      timepoint == "during 40 min" ~ "During 40 Min",
      timepoint == "post 10 min" ~ "Post 10 Min",
      timepoint == "post 15/30/45 min" ~ "Post 30 Min",
      timepoint == "post 3.5/4 hr" ~ "Post 3.5 Hour",
      timepoint == "post 24 hr" ~ "Post 24 Hour",
      TRUE ~ timepoint
    ))
  
  center_df <- center_df %>%
    mutate(timepoint = gsub("^(Endur|Resist)\\.", "", timepoint))%>%
    mutate(timepoint = case_when(
      timepoint == "pre exercise" ~ "Pre-Exercise",
      timepoint == "during 20 min" ~ "During 20 Min",
      timepoint == "during 40 min" ~ "During 40 Min",
      timepoint == "post 10 min" ~ "Post 10 Min",
      timepoint == "post 15/30/45 min" ~ "Post 30 Min",
      timepoint == "post 3.5/4 hr" ~ "Post 3.5 Hour",
      timepoint == "post 24 hr" ~ "Post 24 Hour",
      TRUE ~ timepoint
    ))
  
  timepoint_levels <- c("Pre-Exercise","Post 10 Min","Post 30 Min","Post 3.5 Hour","Post 24 Hour" )
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = timepoint_levels))
  
  center_df <- center_df %>%
    mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = timepoint_levels))
  
  df_list <- tidyr::nest(df, .by = cluster)
  center_df_list <- tidyr::nest(center_df, .by = cluster)
  
  ## Iridescent color scheme
  cmeans_palette <- c("#fefbe9", "#fcf7d5", "#f5f3c1", "#eaf0b5", "#ddecbf",
                      "#d0e7ca", "#c2e3d2", "#b5ddd8", "#a8d8dc", "#9bd2e1",
                      "#8dcbe4", "#81c4e7", "#7bbce7", "#7eb2e4", "#88a5dd",
                      "#9398d2", "#9b8ac4", "#9d7db2", "#9a709e", "#906388",
                      "#805770", "#684957", "#46353a")
  
  plotlist <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df_list)), function(i) {
    df_i <- df_list$data[[i]]
    centroid_i <- center_df_list$data[[i]]
    cluster_name <- as.character(df_list$cluster[i])
    cluster_size <- nrow(df_i %>% distinct(feature))  # Count unique metabolites
    
    ggplot(df_i, aes(x = timepoint, y = z)) +
      geom_line(aes(color = membership, group = feature)) +
      geom_line(aes(x = timepoint, y = center, group = 1),
                data = centroid_i, color = "black") +
      annotate("text", x = 1, y = -Inf,
               label = paste(cluster_size, feature_label),
               hjust = 0, vjust = -1.2, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
      scale_x_discrete(name = NULL, expand = expansion(add = 0.2)) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = ylim) +
      scale_color_gradientn(name = "Membership\nProbability",
                            colors = cmeans_palette,
                            values = seq(0, 1, length.out = length(cmeans_palette)),
                            limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
      labs(y = NULL, title = cluster_name) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
            strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 3)),
            plot.title = element_text(size = rel(0.9), face = "bold",
                                      hjust = 0.5, margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 0)),
            strip.background = element_blank(),
            axis.title.y = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold",
                                        margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 0, r = 8, b = 0, l = 0)),
            axis.text.x = element_text(size = rel(0.9), color = "black",
                                       angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
            axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"))
  })
  
  
  ncol <- min(length(plotlist), ncol)
  nrow <- ceiling(length(plotlist) / ncol)
  # Each cluster occupies a space that is 2x2 inches
  height <- nrow * 2
  width <- ncol * 2 + 0.5 # 0.5 = space for legend
  
  p <- ggarrange(plotlist = plotlist,
                 ncol = ncol,
                 nrow = nrow,
                 common.legend = TRUE,
                 legend = "right")
  p <- annotate_figure(
    p = p,
    left = textGrob("Scaled Z-Score", rot = 90, vjust = 1,
                    gp = gpar(fontsize = 11,
                              fontface = "bold"))
  )
  
  # Save image
  ggsave(filename = filename, plot = p, height = height, width = width, dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
  
  # ============================
  # Build cluster-members dataframe (columns = clusters, rows padded with NA)
  # ============================
  cluster_members_list <- split(cluster_assignment$feature, cluster_assignment$cluster)
  cluster_members_list <- cluster_members_list[order(names(cluster_members_list))]

  cluster_members_list <- lapply(cluster_members_list, function(features) {
    cleaned <- gsub("^(metab|prot|rna)[[:space:]]+", "", features)
    cleaned <- cleaned[!is.na(cleaned) & cleaned != ""]  # remove NAs or empty entries
    cleaned
  })
  
  # Find max length
  max_len <- max(sapply(cluster_members_list, length))
  
  # Pad with NA safely to ensure equal column lengths
  cluster_df <- setNames(
    as.data.frame(
      lapply(cluster_members_list, function(x) {
        c(x, rep(NA, max_len - length(x)))
      }),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),
    names(cluster_members_list)
  )
  
  # Optionally write excel
  if (!is.null(excel_path)) {
    if (!requireNamespace("writexl", quietly = TRUE)) {
      stop("Please install the 'writexl' package to write Excel output: install.packages('writexl')")
    }
    writexl::write_xlsx(list(Clusters = cluster_df), path = excel_path)
  }

  return(list(plot = p, clusters = cluster_df))
}

# requires: ggpubr, writexl (for excel writing)
library(ggpubr)
if (!requireNamespace("writexl", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("writexl")


combine_cmeans_outputs_stacked <- function(res_out, endur_out,
                                           combined_pdf = "/path/to/combined_cmeans_plots.pdf",
                                           combined_excel = "/path/to/combined_cmeans_clusters.xlsx") {
  # --- Required packages ---
  required_libs <- c("ggplot2", "ggpubr", "grid", "writexl", "dplyr", "tidyr", "tibble")
  invisible(lapply(required_libs, function(pkg) {
    if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages(pkg)
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  }))
  
  excel_dir <- dirname(combined_excel)
  plot_dir  <- dirname(combined_pdf)
  
  if (!dir.exists(excel_dir)) {
    dir.create(excel_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    message(glue::glue("📂 Created Excel output directory: {excel_dir}"))
  }
  
  if (!dir.exists(plot_dir)) {
    dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    message(glue::glue("📂 Created Plot output directory: {plot_dir}"))
  }
  
  # --- 1. Prepare dataframes ---
  df_res <- as.data.frame(res_out$clusters, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df_end <- as.data.frame(endur_out$clusters, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  names(df_res) <- paste0("RE_", names(df_res))
  names(df_end) <- paste0("EE_", names(df_end))
  
  n1 <- nrow(df_res)
  n2 <- nrow(df_end)
  maxn <- max(n1, n2)
  if (n1 < maxn) df_res[(n1 + 1):maxn, ] <- NA
  if (n2 < maxn) df_end[(n2 + 1):maxn, ] <- NA
  
  combined_side_by_side <- dplyr::bind_cols(df_end, df_res)
  
  # --- 2. Write Excel file ---
  writexl::write_xlsx(
    x = list(
      Combined_side_by_side = combined_side_by_side,
      Endurance = df_end,
      Resistance = df_res
    ),
    path = combined_excel
  )
  message("✅ Excel saved to: ", combined_excel)
  
  # --- 3. Arrange plots vertically with labels ---
  # Use ggdraw for clean stacking with text labels
  library(cowplot)
  
  # Title grobs
  title_ee <- ggdraw() + draw_label("EE", fontface = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5)
  title_re <- ggdraw() + draw_label("RE", fontface = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5)
  
  # Combine plots vertically with spacing
  stacked_plot <- plot_grid(
    title_ee, endur_out$plot,
    title_re, res_out$plot,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(0.08, 1, 0.08, 1)
  )
  
  # --- 4. Save PDF ---
  ggsave(
    filename = combined_pdf,
    plot = stacked_plot,
    device = "pdf",
    width = 12, height = 6
  )
  message("✅ PDF saved to: ", combined_pdf)
  
  # --- 5. Return combined objects ---
  return(list(
    combined_clusters_side_by_side = combined_side_by_side,
    arranged_plot = stacked_plot,
    pdf_path = combined_pdf,
    excel_path = combined_excel
  ))
}
